item.title: Amitabh Bachchan invests Rs 35 crores in Ayodhya land: Reports
item.description: Bollywood veteran Amitabh Bachchan has further expanded his real estate portfolio in Ayodhya with the purchase of a 2.67-acre land parcel valued at Rs 35 crores. The transaction was facilitated by The House of Abhinandan Lodha (HoABL), the company confirmed on March 6.According to the company, the land parcel is located near HoABL’s 75-acre development project titled ‘The Sarayu’.
